answer: Pick a jury of five. Require three matching verdicts. Slash the two who diverge if the majority holds, and void the round if the panel shares one owner. Rotate one vertex per epoch from a pool no identity can join twice. Attacking costs four colluding jurors plus their stake, honest work costs one answer, so the cheapest attack is dearer than the kernel of real work. No sonnet about decentralization changes that ratio.
